name: Deep Zoom
description: Cinematic macro-photography look for science explainers: glossy and translucent 3D objects (ice, glass, water, metal) lit in a near-black studio, shallow depth of field, slow weighty camera moves and seamless dives from an everyday object down to crystals, molecules, atoms and quarks. Adult, premium, documentary-grade.
fonts: Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "Avenir Next", system-ui, Arial, sans-serif
